      NEWLY CONSTRUCTED APARTMENTS FOR RENT
                                                                 www.ApplyLaPorte.com
                                                               La Porte Apartments is pleased to
                                                               announce applications are now being
                                                               accepted for affordable housing rental
                                                               apartments under construction at 203
                                                               Gramatan Avenue, in the city of Mt.
                                                               Vernon. This building          is     being
                                                               constructed with financing         provided
                                                               through the LIHTC program of the New
                                                               York State Homes and Community
                                                               Renewal and the HOME program. The
                                                               size, rent, and targeted income distribution
                                                               for the apartments are as follows:

Qualified Applicants will be required to meet income guidelines and additional selection criteria. To receive an application,
                                                                                                                  th
mail a SELF ADDRESSED ENVELOPE to: La Porte c/o: The Wavecrest Management Team, 87-14 116 Street,
Richmond Hill, NY 11418, or download an application from www.ApplyLaPorte.com.

There will be a preference for 33% of the apartments for applicants currently residing in the City of Mount Vernon.
